root_cause.text: The ksmbd DACL size accumulation uses u16 variables without overflow detection, allowing integer wrap-around when many ACEs cause the total size to exceed 65535, which corrupts the ACL buffer through incorrect pointer arithmetic.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description: "set_posix_acl_entries_dacl() and set_ntacl_dacl() accumulate ACE sizes in u16 variables. ... accumulated size can wrap past 65535, causing the pointer arithmetic (char *)pndace + *size to land within already-written ACEs." Patch adds check_add_overflow() at each accumulation point to prevent the wrap.
